title: Look Lock, moodboard multi-select & undo, finished-generation pops
notes:
- Seedream: Look Lock — pin a render as the look (Scene / Style), with a history that restores its setup
- Seedream: Lighting creativity slider (0 keeps the cutout's light, 100 invents a cinematic setup)
- Moodboard: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z (20 steps), right-drag to select several cards, group move / delete, Ctrl+A
- Notifications: a 'generation finished' card springs out of the bell while the moodboard is open or the app is in the background, with a chime (volume in the sound menu) and a taskbar flash
- Variants line up with the generation view (thumb chips in the file bar); the overlay eye is never dead
- Home opens a project directly under the purple frame; library button and top bar stay lit while generating
- Gemini chat: calm frosted colour wash; negative prompts always parsed into their box
- Updater v3 (runs outside the app's process tree) + many QA fixes
